WITH filtered_core AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_fee,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        cd1.cd_marital_status,
        cd1.cd_education_status,
        ca.ca_state
    FROM web_returns AS wr
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1
        ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
        ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
        AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
        AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN reason AS r
        ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
    WHERE
        (
            (
                cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
                AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
            )
            OR (
                cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
                AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
            )
            OR (
                cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
                AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
            )
        )
        AND (
            (
                ca.ca_country = 'United States'
                AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
            )
            OR (
                ca.ca_country = 'United States'
                AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
            )
            OR (
                ca.ca_country = 'United States'
                AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
            )
        )
),
joined_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        fc.r_reason_desc,
        fc.wr_refunded_cash,
        fc.wr_fee,
        fc.cd_marital_status,
        fc.cd_education_status,
        fc.ca_state,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM filtered_core AS fc
    JOIN web_sales AS ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = fc.wr_item_sk
        AND ws.ws_order_number = fc.wr_order_number
    JOIN web_page AS wp
        ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND d.d_year = 1998
),
matched_rows AS (
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'D'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
        AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'D'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
        AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'D'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
        AND ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'S'
        AND cd_education_status = 'College'
        AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'S'
        AND cd_education_status = 'College'
        AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'S'
        AND cd_education_status = 'College'
        AND ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
        AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
        AND ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        r_reason_desc,
        ws_quantity,
        wr_refunded_cash,
        wr_fee
    FROM joined_rows
    WHERE
        cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
        AND ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
        AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
)
SELECT
    substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(ws_quantity),
    avg(wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(wr_fee)
FROM matched_rows
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY
    substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(ws_quantity),
    avg(wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
